claude_proposed_widenings.name: apply_condition variant of Effect (spell)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The on-fail branch imposes a persistent condition alongside damage. The spell Effect union only has 'damage' and 'none'. apply_condition already exists in mastery SaveGateRiderResult but has never been lifted into the spell Effect type.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: On a failed save, the target takes 10d12 Psychic damage and can't cast spells or take the Magic action.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: Condition: no_spellcasting (or equivalent named condition)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The debuff is 'can't cast spells or take the Magic action'. The Condition type currently only contains 'prone'. A new Condition value is required to represent any spellcasting-suppression effect.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: can't cast spells or take the Magic action

claude_proposed_widenings.name: compound/sequence Effect variant
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The on-fail branch delivers BOTH 10d12 Psychic damage AND the no-spellcasting condition simultaneously. onFail: Effect is a single Effect; there is no compound or sequence variant that lets one branch fire multiple effects. This requires either a new compound Effect kind or a redesigned branch structure.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: the target takes 10d12 Psychic damage and can't cast spells or take the Magic action

claude_proposed_widenings.name: repeat_save with non-combat cadence (30-day interval)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The on-fail debuff persists until the target passes a saving throw at the end of every 30 days. The repeat_save atom exists in v4 taxonomy but is absent from types.ts. Even if added, the cadence shape currently has no way to express intervals measured in days rather than rounds/turns.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: At the end of every 30 days, the target repeats the save, ending the effect on a success. The effect can also be ended by the Greater Restoration, Heal, or Wish spell.
